description: We are Terra2Orbit a multidisciplinary team exploring how Earth's extreme environments can help prepare humanity for future Moon and Mars exploration. Our goal is to combine Earth observation data, planetary science, data analysis, AI/ML and software development to discover and characterize potential terrestrial analog sites. We welcome passionate collaborators in Earth science, geology, GIS, remote sensing, data science, AI and design who want to turn scientific data into meaningful discoveries
summary:
TerraAnalog AI is an interactive geospatial web application designed to identify, analyze, and compare terrestrial analog sites that mirror the geological, topographical, and environmental conditions of the Moon and Mars. Built with a React and MapLibre GL frontend and a FastAPI backend, the platform integrates satellite imagery and planetary datasets to help researchers evaluate Earth-based testing grounds before deploying off-world missions.

To address the challenge of selecting reliable field-testing locations for lunar and Martian exploration, TerraAnalog AI streamlines site discovery through visual mapping, planetary similarity scoring, and structured geological profiles. By lowering the barrier to finding accessible, scientifically relevant analog environments on Earth, the platform enables space agencies, engineers, and researchers to test rovers, habitats, and mission protocols more efficiently—accelerating safe and cost-effective preparation for future human and robotic space exploration.
details:
TerraAnalog AI is an innovative geospatial web application designed to identify, analyze, and compare terrestrial analog sites on Earth that mirror the geological, topographical, and environmental conditions of the Moon and Mars.

How it works: The platform integrates a high-performance React and MapLibre GL frontend with a robust FastAPI backend. It utilizes real-time satellite imagery and spatial data APIs to allow researchers and space enthusiasts to interactively explore candidate analog environments, evaluate geological properties, and compare their metrics against planetary benchmarks.

Benefits & Impact: Finding reliable Earth-based testing grounds is critical for space exploration. TerraAnalog AI streamlines site discovery, enabling researchers, engineers, and space agencies to test rovers, scientific instruments, and mission protocols in accessible environments before deploying off-world missions, ultimately accelerating safe and cost-effective space preparation.

Tech Stack & Tools:

  • Frontend: React, Vite, MapLibre GL
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI
  • Deployment: Vercel (Frontend), Render (Backend)
  • Version Control & Docs: GitHub, Markdown, MIT License

Creativity & Considerations: The project bridges the gap between planetary science and practical terrestrial field research. The team carefully considered user experience, geospatial responsiveness, and scalability, while also documenting key limitations such as Earth's atmospheric and standard gravity constraints compared to actual planetary bodies.
